subject: [PATCH v2 5/8] nfsd: give the open file cache its own mutex

2026-09-22.patch_summary: This patch introduces a new mutex, nfsd_file_cache_mutex, to protect the open file cache in the NFS server. The global mutex, nfsd_global_mutex, is no longer used for file cache operations, which were previously serialized against server start/stop. The new mutex is held by the file cache initialization and shutdown functions, as well as by readers and walkers that need access to the cache. This change improves concurrency and reduces contention between unrelated namespaces.
